adversarial_probe_registered: Use the smooth divergence-free fields u_n(x)=(0,n^{-1} sin(n x_1),0) on fixed compact sets. Then u_n -> 0 strongly in L3_loc while curl u_n=(0,0,cos(n x_1)) oscillates with direction switching between +/-e3 away from zeros. This is NOT a Navier-Stokes counterexample; it falsifies only the topological inference 'strong L3 velocity convergence => vorticity-direction convergence'.
falsifier: A source-valid compactness/transport theorem deriving stable high-vorticity directional range/coherence for the rescaled sequence or its ancient limit from the actual finite-I hypotheses would overturn the anticipated transport obstruction. A direct pre-limit geometric argument that avoids transporting xi would also bypass, rather than refute, the obstruction.
